```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
model_components AS (
    SELECT mb.component_id, mb.qty::DOUBLE AS qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'SW9-180WAL93-0190'
      AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cb.child_component_id, mc.qty * cb.qty
    FROM model_components mc
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = mc.component_id AND c.is_assembly = TRUE
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = mc.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mc.qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM model_components mc
JOIN component c ON c.component_id = mc.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'FOO-192-WHT-02486'
  AND c.is_assembly = FALSE;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Find the target model
target_model AS (
    SELECT model_id
    FROM company_model
    WHERE model_code = 'ER4-180OAK69-0166'
),
-- Find the target part
target_part AS (
    SELECT component_id
    FROM component
    WHERE component_code = 'GEA-219-WAL-02353'
),
-- Recursive expansion of the model BOM
bom_expansion AS (
    -- Base: model BOM edges
    SELECT
        mb.component_id AS component_id,
        mb.qty::DOUBLE AS qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN target_model tm ON mb.model_id = tm.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)

    UNION ALL

    -- Recursive: expand assembly components via component BOM
    SELECT
        cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
        be.qty * cb.qty AS qty
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN component c ON be.component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = be.component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = TRUE
      AND cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(be.qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM bom_expansion be
JOIN target_part tp ON be.component_id = tp.component_id;
```

```sql
-- Resolve the target model

    SELECT model_id
    FROM company_model
    WHERE model_code = 'VI5-160GRY58-0446'

-- Recursively explode the BOM starting from the model's components

        cb.child_component_id,

    JOIN component c ON be.component_id = c.component_id
```

```sql
    -- Base: direct component BOM edges for the target part
    SELECT 
        cb.parent_component_id,
        cb.child_component_id,
        cb.qty
    FROM component_bom cb
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand sub-assemblies
    SELECT 
        cb.parent_component_id,
        pt.child_component_id,
        cb.qty * pt.qty
    FROM component_bom cb
    JOIN part_tree pt ON cb.child_component_id = pt.parent_component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
model_part_qty AS (
    -- Sum quantities of the target part per model through all assembly paths
    SELECT 
        mb.model_id,
        SUM(pt.qty * mb.qty) AS part_qty_per_model
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN part_tree pt ON mb.component_id = pt.parent_component_id
    JOIN component c ON pt.child_component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE c.component_code = 'LEG-806-BLK-02750'
      AND c.is_assembly = false
      AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    GROUP BY mb.model_id
),
bundle_items AS (
    -- Get item SKUs in the bundle
    SELECT 
        bi.item_sku_id,
        bi.qty AS item_qty
    FROM sales_sku bundle
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bundle.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE bundle.sku_code = 'BDL-DE-0328'
      AND bundle.is_bundle = true
),
item_model_qty AS (
    -- Map item SKUs to models
    SELECT 
        bi.item_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS sku_model_qty
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
)
SELECT
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
```

```sql
    -- Non-bundle SKUs: direct model mapping
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, ol.qty AS order_qty, sm.model_id, sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id

    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON l.sku_id = sk.sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sk.sku_id = sm.sku_id

      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND sk.is_bundle = FALSE
    UNION ALL
    -- Bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs, then to models
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, ol.qty AS order_qty, sm.model_id, bi.qty * sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON l.sku_id = sk.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON sk.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    JOIN sales_sku item_sk ON bi.item_sku_id = item_sk.sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON item_sk.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.store_name = 'Amazon-DE-01'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND sk.is_bundle = TRUE
),
-- 2. Explode model BOM to components (recursive), tracking qty per unit and validity date
model_components AS (
    -- Base: model -> component edges
    SELECT om.order_id, om.order_date, om.order_qty, om.model_qty,
           mb.component_id, mb.qty AS comp_qty
    FROM order_models om
    JOIN model_bom mb ON om.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= om.order_date
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR om.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
    UNION ALL
    -- Recursive: assembly component -> child component
    SELECT mc.order_id, mc.order_date, mc.order_qty, mc.model_qty,
           cb.child_component_id, mc.comp_qty * cb.qty
    FROM model_components mc
    JOIN component c ON mc.component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON mc.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = TRUE
      AND cb.valid_from <= mc.order_date
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR mc.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)
-- 3. Sum quantities for the target part

FROM model_components mc
JOIN component c ON mc.component_id = c.component_id
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE part_tree AS (
    -- Start from the target part and walk up to all ancestors
    SELECT 
        c.component_id,
        c.component_id AS ancestor_id,
        1.0 AS qty_per_ancestor
    FROM component c
    WHERE c.component_code = 'CAB-573-GRY-01774'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        pt.component_id,
        cb.parent_component_id AS ancestor_id,
        pt.qty_per_ancestor * cb.qty AS qty_per_ancestor
    FROM part_tree pt
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.child_component_id = pt.ancestor_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Get all components (parts and assemblies) that contain the target part, with total qty per unit
component_usage AS (
    SELECT 
        ancestor_id AS component_id,
        SUM(qty_per_ancestor) AS qty_per_unit
    FROM part_tree
    WHERE ancestor_id != component_id  -- exclude the part itself
    GROUP BY ancestor_id
),
-- Expand bundle to item SKUs
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.item_sku_id,
        bi.qty AS item_qty
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = b.sku_id
    WHERE b.sku_code = 'BDL-US-0239'
),
-- Map item SKUs to models
item_models AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.item_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = bi.item_sku_id
),
-- Map models to components (top-level BOM)
model_components AS (
    SELECT 
        im.item_qty,
        im.model_qty,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty AS component_qty
    FROM item_models im
    JOIN model_bom mb ON mb.model_id = im.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
-- Sum total qty of target part per bundle unit
SELECT SUM(
    mc.item_qty * mc.model_qty * mc.component_qty * COALESCE(cu.qty_per_unit, 0.0)
) AS total_qty
FROM model_components mc
LEFT JOIN component_usage cu ON cu.component_id = mc.component_id
WHERE cu.component_id IS NOT NULL;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find the component_id for the given model code
model_component AS (
    SELECT c.component_id
    FROM component c
    WHERE c.component_code = 'AE4-120WAL62-0547'
),
-- Find all components in the model's BOM with current validity
model_bom_components AS (
    SELECT 
        mb.component_id as root_component_id,
        mb.qty as root_qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN company_model cm ON mb.model_id = cm.model_id
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'AE4-120WAL62-0547'
      AND mb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all component BOMs
exploded_bom AS (
    -- Base case: start with components directly in model BOM
    SELECT 
        mbc.root_component_id as component_id,
        mbc.root_qty as total_qty,
        c.is_assembly
    FROM model_bom_components mbc
    JOIN component c ON mbc.root_component_id = c.component_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: expand assemblies
    SELECT 
        cb.child_component_id as component_id,
        (eb.total_qty * cb.qty) as total_qty,
        c.is_assembly
    FROM exploded_bom eb
    JOIN component_bom cb ON eb.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    JOIN component c ON cb.child_component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE eb.is_assembly = true
      AND cb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
)
-- Sum up costs for all parts (non-assemblies)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(eb.total_qty * c.unit_cost), 2) as total_parts_cost
FROM exploded_bom eb
JOIN component c ON eb.component_id = c.component_id
WHERE c.is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
    FROM item_models
    GROUP BY model_id

    SELECT

        mb.component_id,
```

```sql
    SELECT item_sku_id, qty as bundle_item_qty
    FROM bundle_item
    WHERE bundle_sku_id = (SELECT sku_id FROM sales_sku WHERE sku_code = 'BDL-US-0361')
),
-- Get models for each item SKU with their quantities
item_models AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.item_sku_id,
        bi.bundle_item_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty as model_qty
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),
-- Get all components from model BOMs
model_components AS (
    SELECT 
        im.bundle_item_qty,
        im.model_qty,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty as component_qty
    FROM item_models im
    JOIN model_bom mb ON im.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all sub-assemblies
exploded AS (
    -- Base: start with components from model BOMs
    SELECT 
        mc.bundle_item_qty,
        mc.model_qty,
        mc.component_id,
        mc.component_qty as path_qty
    FROM model_components mc
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand assemblies
    SELECT 
        e.bundle_item_qty,
        e.model_qty,
        cb.child_component_id as component_id,
        e.path_qty * cb.qty as path_qty
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN component c ON e.component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON e.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
      AND cb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'

)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Expand each sold SKU (from completed DE 2025 orders) down to company models, multiplying quantities through bundles
sku_units AS (
    SELECT l.sku_id, SUM(ol.qty) AS units
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id

    GROUP BY l.sku_id
),

    SELECT su.sku_id AS root_sku, su.units AS qty, 'sku' AS kind, sk.sku_code AS code
    FROM sku_units su
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON sk.sku_id = su.sku_id

     AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= c.valid_to)

)
```

```sql
            WHEN ca.valid_to IS NULL THEN cb.valid_to

            WHEN mb.valid_to IS NULL THEN ca.valid_to
```

```sql
    FROM item_sku_models

    FROM bom_explosion be
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE part_tree AS (
    -- Find the specific part component
    SELECT component_id
    FROM component
    WHERE component_code = 'LEG-148-WAL-02453'
      AND is_assembly = false
),
component_bom_recursive AS (
    -- Base: direct component BOM edges from assemblies to this part
    SELECT 
        cb.parent_component_id,
        cb.child_component_id,
        cb.qty,
        cb.valid_from,
        cb.valid_to
    FROM component_bom cb
    INNER JOIN part_tree pt ON cb.child_component_id = pt.component_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: walk up the component BOM tree
    SELECT 
        cb.parent_component_id,
        cb.child_component_id,
        cb.qty * cbr.qty,
        cb.valid_from,
        cb.valid_to
    FROM component_bom cb
    INNER JOIN component_bom_recursive cbr ON cb.child_component_id = cbr.parent_component_id
),
model_part_qty AS (
    -- Get quantity of the part per model, considering BOM validity on order date
    SELECT 
        mb.model_id,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty * COALESCE(cbr.qty, 1) AS part_qty_per_unit,
        mb.valid_from,
        mb.valid_to
    FROM model_bom mb
    LEFT JOIN component_bom_recursive cbr 
        ON mb.component_id = cbr.parent_component_id
    INNER JOIN part_tree pt ON pt.component_id = cbr.child_component_id OR mb.component_id = pt.component_id
    WHERE mb.component_id = pt.component_id OR cbr.child_component_id = pt.component_id
),
order_lines_exploded AS (
    -- Get all order lines from the specific store in 2023, completed orders
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS order_qty,
        ol.unit_price,
        o.order_date,
        l.sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS sku_model_qty
    FROM order_line ol
    INNER JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    INNER JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    INNER JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    LEFT JOIN sku_model sm ON l.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE s.store_name = 'Wayfair-JP-23'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2023
      AND sm.model_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle items
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty * bi.qty AS order_qty,
        ol.unit_price,
        o.order_date,
        bi.item_sku_id AS sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS sku_model_qty
    FROM order_line ol
    INNER JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    INNER JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    INNER JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    INNER JOIN sales_sku ss ON l.sku_id = ss.sku_id AND ss.is_bundle = true
    INNER JOIN bundle_item bi ON ss.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    INNER JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE s.store_name = 'Wayfair-JP-23'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2023
)

    SUM(ole.order_qty * ole.sku_model_qty * mpq.part_qty_per_unit) AS total_units
FROM order_lines_exploded ole
INNER JOIN model_part_qty mpq 
    ON ole.model_id = mpq.model_id

    AND (mpq.valid_to IS NULL OR ole.order_date <= mpq.valid_to)
```

```sql
        SUM(bp.edge_qty) AS qty_per_model
    FROM model_bom mb

    JOIN part_tree pt ON pt.component_id = bp.parent_component_id
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_paths AS (
    -- Start from the target part and walk up to parent assemblies
    SELECT 
        cb.parent_component_id,
        cb.child_component_id,
        cb.qty,
        cb.valid_from,
        cb.valid_to
    FROM component_bom cb
    JOIN component c ON cb.child_component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE c.component_code = 'TAB-874-OAK-02567'
      AND c.is_assembly = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        cb.parent_component_id,
        cb.child_component_id,
        cb.qty,
        cb.valid_from,
        cb.valid_to
    FROM component_bom cb
    JOIN bom_paths bp ON cb.child_component_id = bp.parent_component_id
),
-- Get all components that contain the target part (directly or indirectly)
containing_components AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT parent_component_id AS component_id
    FROM bom_paths
    UNION
    SELECT child_component_id FROM bom_paths
),
-- Find all models that use these components
model_components AS (
    SELECT 
        mb.model_id,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty,
        mb.valid_from,
        mb.valid_to
    FROM model_bom mb
    WHERE mb.component_id IN (SELECT component_id FROM containing_components)
       OR mb.component_id IN (SELECT child_component_id FROM bom_paths WHERE parent_component_id IN (SELECT component_id FROM containing_components))
),
-- Get all SKUs that map to these models
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty
    FROM sku_model sm
    WHERE sm.model_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT model_id FROM model_components)
),
-- Expand bundles to their item SKUs
expanded_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_id AS item_sku_id,
        1 AS qty
    FROM sales_sku s
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs expanded to items
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id AS sku_id,
        bi.item_sku_id,
        bi.qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
),
-- Calculate total quantity of target part per SKU (considering BOM validity per order date)
sku_part_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        es.sku_id,
        es.item_sku_id,
        es.qty AS sku_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty,
        mc.component_id,
        mc.qty AS component_qty,
        mc.valid_from,
        mc.valid_to
    FROM expanded_skus es
    JOIN sku_models sm ON es.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    JOIN model_components mc ON sm.model_id = mc.model_id
    WHERE mc.component_id IN (SELECT child_component_id FROM bom_paths)
       OR mc.component_id IN (SELECT parent_component_id FROM bom_paths)
),
-- Calculate the multiplier from component to target part
component_multipliers AS (
    SELECT 
        bp.parent_component_id AS component_id,
        bp.child_component_id,
        bp.qty,
        bp.valid_from,
        bp.valid_to
    FROM bom_paths bp
),
-- Final calculation: join orders with listings and compute part consumption
order_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.qty AS order_qty,
        spq.sku_qty,
        spq.model_qty,
        spq.component_qty,
        spq.valid_from,
        spq.valid_to,
        o.order_date
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN store st ON l.store_id = st.store_id
    JOIN sku_part_qty spq ON l.sku_id = spq.sku_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND st.store_name = 'Amazon-JP-13'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2023
      AND o.order_date >= spq.valid_from
      AND (spq.valid_to IS NULL OR o.order_date <= spq.valid_to)
)
SELECT 
    SUM(
        oc.order_qty * 
        oc.sku_qty * 
        oc.model_qty * 
        oc.component_qty
    ) AS total_units
FROM order_consumption oc;
```

```sql
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = cbom.parent_component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
),

bom_paths AS (
    SELECT 
        at.part_id,
        at.current_component_id AS assembly_id,
        1.0 AS qty_multiplier
    FROM assembly_tree at
    WHERE at.current_component_id != at.part_id
    
    UNION ALL

        bp.part_id,
        cbom.parent_component_id,
        bp.qty_multiplier * cbom.qty
    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN component_bom cbom ON cbom.child_component_id = bp.assembly_id
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = cbom.parent_component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
),

    FROM model_bom mbom
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE current_component_bom AS (
    SELECT parent_component_id, child_component_id, qty
    FROM component_bom
    WHERE valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= valid_to)
),
current_model_bom AS (
    SELECT model_id, component_id, qty
    FROM model_bom
    WHERE valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= valid_to)
),
target_component AS (
    SELECT component_id
    FROM component
    WHERE component_code = 'TAB-623-OAK-01932'
),
component_paths AS (
    -- Start from all components that are direct children in current component BOM
    SELECT 
        c.parent_component_id AS root_component_id,
        c.child_component_id,
        c.qty AS total_qty
    FROM current_component_bom c
    JOIN target_component t ON c.child_component_id = t.component_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recurse up: find parents of current root
    SELECT 
        c.parent_component_id AS root_component_id,
        cp.root_component_id AS child_component_id,
        cp.total_qty * c.qty AS total_qty
    FROM current_component_bom c
    JOIN component_paths cp ON c.child_component_id = cp.root_component_id
),
all_assembly_components AS (
    -- All assembly components that contain target (directly or nested)
    SELECT DISTINCT root_component_id AS component_id
    FROM component_paths
    
    UNION
    
    -- The target itself if it's used directly in models
    SELECT component_id FROM target_component
),
model_components AS (
    -- Models that directly use target or any assembly containing target
    SELECT DISTINCT m.model_id
    FROM current_model_bom m
    WHERE m.component_id IN (SELECT component_id FROM all_assembly_components)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Also need to check: models using assemblies that contain target at deeper levels
    -- Actually the above handles direct usage; for nested assemblies in models,
    -- we need to expand model BOM assemblies recursively
    SELECT DISTINCT m.model_id
    FROM current_model_bom m
    JOIN component_paths cp ON m.component_id = cp.root_component_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT model_id) AS model_count
FROM model_components
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE current_component_bom AS (
    SELECT parent_component_id, child_component_id, qty
    FROM component_bom
    WHERE valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= valid_to)
),
current_model_bom AS (
    SELECT model_id, component_id, qty
    FROM model_bom
    WHERE valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= valid_to)
),
part_explosion AS (
    -- Start from all components that are parts (not assemblies)
    SELECT 
        c.component_id AS root_component_id,
        c.component_id AS child_component_id,
        1 AS total_qty
    FROM component c
    WHERE c.is_assembly = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand upward through component BOM: child -> parent
    SELECT 
        cb.parent_component_id AS root_component_id,
        pe.child_component_id,
        pe.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM part_explosion pe
    JOIN current_component_bom cb ON pe.root_component_id = cb.child_component_id
),
target_part AS (
    SELECT component_id 
    FROM component 
    WHERE component_code = 'FAS-535-GRY-01684'
),
models_with_part AS (
    -- Models that directly contain the target part
    SELECT 
        cmb.model_id,
        cmb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM current_model_bom cmb
    JOIN target_part tp ON cmb.component_id = tp.component_id
    
    UNION
    
    -- Models that contain assemblies that contain the target part
    SELECT 
        cmb.model_id,
        cmb.qty * pe.total_qty AS total_qty
    FROM current_model_bom cmb
    JOIN part_explosion pe ON cmb.component_id = pe.root_component_id
    JOIN target_part tp ON pe.child_component_id = tp.component_id
),
skus_with_models AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sm.sku_id
    FROM sku_model sm
    JOIN models_with_part mwp ON sm.model_id = mwp.model_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.sku_id)
FROM sales_sku s
JOIN skus_with_models swm ON s.sku_id = swm.sku_id
WHERE s.is_bundle = false;
```

```sql
    SELECT model_id, component_id, qty
    FROM model_bom
    WHERE valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= valid_to)

    FROM component_bom
    WHERE valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= valid_to)
),

model_components AS (
    -- Base case: direct components from model BOM
    SELECT 
        m.model_id,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM company_model m
    JOIN current_model_bom mb ON m.model_id = mb.model_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: expand assemblies
    SELECT 
        mc.model_id,
        cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
```

```sql
    WHERE component_code = 'CAB-903-WAL-02318'

    -- Base case: the target part itself

        component_id AS parent_component_id,
        1 AS qty_multiplier
    FROM target_part
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: find assemblies that contain any of the current components

        cb.parent_component_id,
        pct.qty_multiplier * cb.qty AS qty_multiplier
    FROM component_bom cb
    JOIN parents_containing_target pct ON cb.child_component_id = pct.parent_component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' 
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM component c 
          WHERE c.component_id = cb.parent_component_id AND c.is_assembly = true
      )
),

assemblies_with_target AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT parent_component_id
    FROM parents_containing_target
    WHERE parent_component_id != (SELECT component_id FROM target_part)
),

-- Also include the target part itself if we want to find models that use it directly

    SELECT component_id AS comp_id FROM target_part
    UNION
    SELECT parent_component_id FROM assemblies_with_target
),

    SELECT DISTINCT mb.model_id
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get the component_id for the target part
target_part AS (
    SELECT component_id 
    FROM component 
    WHERE component_code = 'GEA-681-BLK-02200'
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode all component BOMs from assemblies down to parts
-- Starting from all components that appear as parents in model_bom or component_bom
component_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct children of assemblies in component_bom
    SELECT 
        cb.parent_component_id AS root_component_id,
        cb.child_component_id,
        cb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM component_bom cb
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' 
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: go deeper into sub-assemblies
    SELECT 
        ce.root_component_id,
        cb.child_component_id,
        ce.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM component_explosion ce
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = ce.child_component_id AND c.is_assembly = true
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = ce.child_component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' 
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
),

-- All components (assemblies and parts) that are used in models directly
model_components AS (
    SELECT 
        mb.model_id,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' 
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
),

-- All components at any level under each model
model_all_components AS (
    -- Direct components from model_bom
    SELECT 
        mc.model_id,
        mc.component_id,
        mc.total_qty
    FROM model_components mc
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Components from exploded component BOMs
    SELECT 
        mc.model_id,
        ce.child_component_id AS component_id,
        mc.total_qty * ce.total_qty AS total_qty
    FROM model_components mc
    JOIN component_explosion ce ON ce.root_component_id = mc.component_id
),

-- Non-bundle SKUs and their models
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS sku_model_qty
    FROM sku_model sm
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ss.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false
)

-- Count distinct non-bundle SKUs that contain the target part at any level
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sku_models.sku_id) AS sku_count
FROM sku_models
JOIN model_all_components mac ON mac.model_id = sku_models.model_id
WHERE mac.component_id = (SELECT component_id FROM target_part);
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE model_components AS (
    -- Base: direct components in model BOM
    SELECT 
        mb.model_id,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty as total_qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' 
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: explode assembly components
    SELECT 
        mc.model_id,
        cb.child_component_id,
        mc.total_qty * cb.qty as total_qty
    FROM model_components mc
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = mc.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' 
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM component c WHERE c.component_id = mc.component_id AND c.is_assembly = true)
),
target_model AS (
    -- Find model_id for SW6-120GRY13-0789
    SELECT model_id 
    FROM company_model 
    WHERE model_code = 'SW6-120GRY13-0789'
),
sku_models AS (
    -- Map non-bundle SKUs to their models
    SELECT 
        sm.sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty
    FROM sku_model sm
),
item_skus_with_target AS (
    -- Find item SKUs that map to the target model (directly or through components)
    SELECT DISTINCT sm.sku_id
    FROM sku_models sm
    WHERE sm.model_id = (SELECT model_id FROM target_model)
    
    UNION
    
    -- Also check if target model appears as a component in another model's BOM
    SELECT DISTINCT sm.sku_id
    FROM sku_models sm
    JOIN model_components mc ON mc.model_id = sm.model_id
    WHERE mc.component_id = (SELECT model_id FROM target_model)
),

    -- Find bundles that contain at least one item SKU with the target model

    FROM bundle_item bi
    WHERE bi.item_sku_id IN (SELECT sku_id FROM item_skus_with_target)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as bundle_count
FROM bundle_skus_with_target bst
JOIN sales_sku ss ON ss.sku_id = bst.bundle_sku_id AND ss.is_bundle = true;
```

```sql
        im.bundle_sku_id,
        im.item_sku_id,
```

```sql
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        c.component_id
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition uc_sku 
        ON uc_sku.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc_sku.parent_code = s.sku_code
        AND uc_sku.child_kind = 'model'
        AND uc_sku.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'

    JOIN u_composition uc_model

        AND uc_model.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (uc_model.valid_to IS NULL OR uc_model.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    JOIN component c
        ON c.component_code = uc_model.child_code
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find the model_id for the target model
target_model AS (
    SELECT model_id
    FROM company_model
    WHERE model_code = 'ER6-120GRY30-0515'
),

-- Get all SKUs that map directly to the target model
direct_skus AS (
    SELECT sku_id, qty as model_qty
    FROM sku_model
    WHERE model_id = (SELECT model_id FROM target_model)
),

-- Get all item SKUs inside bundles that map to the target model
-- Need to find: bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model
bundle_item_skus AS (
    SELECT bi.bundle_sku_id, bi.item_sku_id, bi.qty as item_qty_in_bundle, sm.qty as model_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE sm.model_id = (SELECT model_id FROM target_model)
),

-- All SKUs that contribute to the target model, with their model multiplier
all_contributing_skus AS (
    -- Direct SKUs
    SELECT sku_id, model_qty as total_model_qty, FALSE as is_bundle_sku
    FROM direct_skus
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs (the bundle itself is what gets sold)
    SELECT bundle_sku_id as sku_id, item_qty_in_bundle * model_qty as total_model_qty, TRUE as is_bundle_sku
    FROM bundle_item_skus
),

-- Get all listings for these SKUs
relevant_listings AS (
    SELECT l.listing_id, l.sku_id, s.total_model_qty
    FROM listing l
    JOIN all_contributing_skus s ON l.sku_id = s.sku_id
),

-- Calculate total units sold
sales AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(ol.qty * rl.total_model_qty) as total_units
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN relevant_listings rl ON ol.listing_id = rl.listing_id
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2023
)

SELECT COALESCE(total_units, 0) as total_units_sold FROM sales
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find all SKUs that map directly to the target model
direct_skus AS (
    SELECT sm.sku_id, sm.qty as model_qty
    FROM company_model cm
    JOIN sku_model sm ON cm.model_id = sm.model_id
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'ER3-140OAK94-0094'
),
-- Find all bundle SKUs that contain item SKUs mapping to the target model
bundle_skus AS (
    SELECT bi.bundle_sku_id, sm.sku_id as item_sku_id, bi.qty as bundle_item_qty, sm.qty as model_qty
    FROM company_model cm
    JOIN sku_model sm ON cm.model_id = sm.model_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON sm.sku_id = bi.item_sku_id
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'ER3-140OAK94-0094'
),
-- Combine all SKUs that contribute to the model sales
all_contributing_skus AS (
    SELECT sku_id, model_qty, 1 as bundle_multiplier
    FROM direct_skus
    UNION ALL
    SELECT bundle_sku_id as sku_id, model_qty, bundle_item_qty as bundle_multiplier
    FROM bundle_skus
),
-- Get all listings for these SKUs
relevant_listings AS (
    SELECT l.listing_id, l.sku_id, acs.model_qty, acs.bundle_multiplier
    FROM listing l
    JOIN all_contributing_skus acs ON l.sku_id = acs.sku_id
),
-- Calculate total units sold
sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(ol.qty * rl.model_qty * rl.bundle_multiplier) as total_units
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN relevant_listings rl ON ol.listing_id = rl.listing_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
)
SELECT COALESCE(total_units, 0)::BIGINT as units_sold FROM sales
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE model_skus AS (
    -- Direct SKU to model mappings
    SELECT 
        c.parent_code AS sku_code,
        c.qty AS direct_qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku' 
      AND c.child_kind = 'model'
      AND c.child_code = 'VI1-140WHT65-0259'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2025-12-31'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2025-01-01')
),
bundle_paths AS (
    -- Recursive: find all SKUs that contain this model through bundles
    SELECT 
        c.parent_code AS sku_code,
        c.qty AS path_qty,
        c.parent_code AS root_sku
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.child_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.child_code IN (SELECT sku_code FROM model_skus)
      AND c.valid_from <= '2025-12-31'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2025-01-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        c.parent_code,
        c.qty * bp.path_qty,
        bp.root_sku
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN bundle_paths bp ON c.child_code = bp.sku_code
    WHERE c.child_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2025-12-31'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2025-01-01')
),
all_sku_qty AS (
    -- Direct SKUs
    SELECT sku_code, direct_qty AS qty_per_unit
    FROM model_skus
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs (root SKUs that contain the model)
    SELECT root_sku AS sku_code, path_qty AS qty_per_unit
    FROM bundle_paths
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ol.qty * aq.qty_per_unit), 0) AS total_units
FROM all_sku_qty aq
JOIN sales_sku ss ON ss.sku_code = aq.sku_code
```

```sql
    -- Direct SKU to model mappings (non-bundle SKUs)
    SELECT 
        c.parent_code AS sku_code,
        c.child_code AS model_code,
        c.qty AS qty_per_sku
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku' 
      AND c.child_kind = 'model'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2024-12-31'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2024-01-01')
),
bundle_contents AS (
    -- Bundle SKU to item SKU mappings
    SELECT 
        c.parent_code AS bundle_sku_code,
        c.child_code AS item_sku_code,
        c.qty AS qty_per_bundle
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku' 
      AND c.child_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2024-12-31'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2024-01-01')
),
recursive_sku_to_model AS (
    -- Anchor: direct SKU to model
    SELECT 
        sku_code,
        model_code,
        qty_per_sku AS total_qty
    FROM sku_to_model
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model
    SELECT 
        bc.bundle_sku_code AS sku_code,
        rsm.model_code,
        bc.qty_per_bundle * rsm.total_qty AS total_qty
    FROM bundle_contents bc
    JOIN recursive_sku_to_model rsm ON bc.item_sku_code = rsm.sku_code
),
model_sales AS (

    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id

    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(ms.order_qty * rsm.total_qty), 0) AS total_units
```

```sql
    -- Direct SKU to model mappings (non-bundle SKUs)
    SELECT

        m.model_id,

    JOIN u_composition uc

        AND uc.parent_code = s.sku_code 
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
        AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    JOIN company_model m ON m.model_code = uc.child_code
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs, then to models
    SELECT 
        b.sku_id,
        b.sku_code,
        m.model_id,
        m.model_code,
        bundle_uc.qty * item_uc.qty AS qty_per_unit
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN u_composition bundle_uc 
        ON bundle_uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND bundle_uc.parent_code = b.sku_code 
        AND bundle_uc.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND bundle_uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (bundle_uc.valid_to IS NULL OR bundle_uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')

        AND item_uc.child_kind = 'model'
        AND item_uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_explode AS (
    -- Start from order lines for the specific store and year
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.qty AS order_qty,
        l.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        s.is_bundle,
        ol.order_date
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON l.sku_id = s.sku_id
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN store st ON o.store_id = st.store_id
    WHERE st.store_name = 'Amazon-CA-14'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2024

    UNION ALL

    -- Explode composition edges valid on the order date
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_qty * uc.qty AS order_qty,
        NULL AS sku_id,
        uc.child_code AS sku_code,
        NULL AS is_bundle,
        be.order_date
    FROM bom_explode be
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_code = be.sku_code
       AND uc.parent_kind = CASE WHEN be.is_bundle THEN 'sku' ELSE 'sku' END
       AND uc.valid_from <= be.order_date
       AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    WHERE be.is_bundle = TRUE

    UNION ALL

    -- Explode from SKU to model
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_qty * uc.qty AS order_qty,
        NULL AS sku_id,
        uc.child_code AS sku_code,
        NULL AS is_bundle,
        be.order_date
    FROM bom_explode be
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_code = be.sku_code
       AND uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
       AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
       AND uc.valid_from <= be.order_date
       AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    WHERE be.is_bundle = FALSE

    UNION ALL

    -- Explode from model to component
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_qty * uc.qty AS order_qty,
        NULL AS sku_id,
        uc.child_code AS sku_code,
        NULL AS is_bundle,
        be.order_date
    FROM bom_explode be
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_code = be.sku_code
       AND uc.parent_kind = 'model'
       AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
       AND uc.valid_from <= be.order_date
       AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= uc.valid_to)

    UNION ALL

    -- Explode assembly component to sub-components
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_qty * uc.qty AS order_qty,
        NULL AS sku_id,
        uc.child_code AS sku_code,
        NULL AS is_bundle,
        be.order_date
    FROM bom_explode be
    JOIN component c ON be.sku_code = c.component_code
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_code = be.sku_code
       AND uc.parent_kind = 'component'
       AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
       AND uc.valid_from <= be.order_date
       AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    WHERE c.is_assembly = TRUE
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(be.order_qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM bom_explode be
JOIN component c ON be.sku_code = c.component_code
WHERE c.component_code = 'MOT-228-WAL-00998'
  AND c.is_assembly = FALSE;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all completed orders from Wayfair-US-05 in 2023
wayfair_store AS (
    SELECT store_id 
    FROM store 
    WHERE store_name = 'Wayfair-US-05'
),

completed_orders_2023 AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date
    FROM orders o
    JOIN wayfair_store ws ON o.store_id = ws.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2023-12-31'
),

-- Get all order lines with their SKUs and quantities
order_lines_with_sku AS (
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.order_date,
        ol.qty as line_qty,
        l.sku_id
    FROM completed_orders_2023 co
    JOIN order_line ol ON co.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
),

-- Expand bundles: for bundle SKUs, get their item SKUs
-- For non-bundle SKUs, keep as-is
expanded_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs directly
    SELECT 
        ols.order_id,
        ols.order_date,
        ols.line_qty,
        ols.sku_id,
        ols.line_qty as sku_qty  -- qty of this SKU in the order line
    FROM order_lines_with_sku ols
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ols.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs expanded to their items
    SELECT 
        ols.order_id,
        ols.order_date,
        ols.line_qty,
        bi.item_sku_id as sku_id,
        ols.line_qty * bi.qty as sku_qty  -- bundle qty * item qty within bundle
    FROM order_lines_with_sku ols
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ols.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ss.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
),

-- Map SKUs to models with quantities
sku_to_models AS (
    SELECT 
        es.order_id,
        es.order_date,
        es.sku_qty * sm.qty as model_qty,  -- total qty of model needed
        sm.model_id
    FROM expanded_skus es
    JOIN sku_model sm ON es.sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Get model BOM components valid on order date
model_bom_valid AS (
    SELECT 
        stm.order_id,
        stm.order_date,
        stm.model_qty * mb.qty as component_qty,
        mb.component_id
    FROM sku_to_models stm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON stm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= stm.order_date
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR stm.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
),

-- Recursive explosion of component BOMs
-- Start with model BOM results and recursively expand assemblies
recursive_bom AS (
    -- Base: components from model BOM
    SELECT 
        mbv.order_id,
        mbv.order_date,
        mbv.component_qty as qty,
        mbv.component_id
    FROM model_bom_valid mbv
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand assemblies using component BOM valid on order date
    SELECT 
        rb.order_id,
        rb.order_date,
        rb.qty * cb.qty as qty,
        cb.child_component_id as component_id
    FROM recursive_bom rb
    JOIN component c ON rb.component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON c.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
      AND cb.valid_from <= rb.order_date
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR rb.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
),

-- Get the part we need: MOT-147-BLK-00200
target_part AS (
    SELECT component_id
    FROM component
    WHERE component_code = 'MOT-147-BLK-00200'
)

-- Sum all quantities of the target part consumed
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all order lines for the store in 2023 with their SKUs
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS order_line_qty,
        ol.unit_price,
        o.order_date,
        l.sku_id
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN store s ON l.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE s.store_name = 'Shopify-CA-09'
    AND o.status = 'completed'
    AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
    AND o.order_date < '2024-01-01'
),

-- Expand bundle SKUs to their item SKUs, or pass through non-bundle SKUs
expanded_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs: pass through directly
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.order_line_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.sku_id,
        ol.order_line_qty AS sku_qty  -- qty of this SKU in the order line
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ol.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.order_line_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        bi.item_sku_id AS sku_id,
        ol.order_line_qty * bi.qty AS sku_qty  -- bundle qty * item qty per bundle
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ol.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ss.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
),

-- Get model quantities for each SKU
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        es.order_id,
        es.line_no,
        es.order_line_qty,
        es.order_date,
        es.sku_id,
        es.sku_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_per_sku_qty,
        es.sku_qty * sm.qty AS total_model_qty
    FROM expanded_skus es
    JOIN sku_model sm ON es.sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode model BOM to parts
model_parts AS (
    -- Base: start with models and their direct components
    SELECT 
        sm.order_id,
        sm.line_no,
        sm.order_date,
        sm.total_model_qty AS parent_qty,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty AS bom_qty,
        sm.total_model_qty * mb.qty AS total_qty,
        1 AS level
    FROM sku_models sm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON sm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= sm.order_date
    AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR sm.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: explode assembly components
    SELECT 
        mp.order_id,
        mp.line_no,
        mp.order_date,
        mp.total_qty AS parent_qty,
        cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
        cb.qty AS bom_qty,
        mp.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty,
        mp.level + 1 AS level
    FROM model_parts mp
    JOIN component c ON mp.component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON c.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
    AND cb.valid_from <= mp.order_date
    AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR mp.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)

-- Sum up total consumption of the target part
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mp.total_qty), 0) AS total_consumed
FROM model_parts mp
JOIN component c ON mp.component_id = c.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'FAS-427-GRY-01954'
AND c.is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all completed orders for Amazon-US-00 in 2024
store_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE s.store_name = 'Amazon-US-00'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01'
),
-- Get order lines with their SKU and quantity
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.qty as line_qty,
        l.sku_id,
        so.order_date
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN store_orders so ON ol.order_id = so.order_id
),
-- Expand bundles: for bundle SKUs, get their item SKUs
expanded_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs (direct model mapping)
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_qty,
        ol.sku_id,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.sku_id as original_sku_id,
        ol.line_qty as original_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ol.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_qty * bi.qty as line_qty,
        bi.item_sku_id as sku_id,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.sku_id as original_sku_id,
        ol.line_qty as original_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ol.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ss.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
),
-- Get model quantities for each SKU
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        es.order_id,
        es.line_qty * sm.qty as model_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        es.order_date
    FROM expanded_skus es
    JOIN sku_model sm ON es.sku_id = sm.sku_id
),
-- Get components from model BOM
model_components AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.order_id,
        sm.model_qty * mb.qty as component_qty,
        mb.component_id,
        sm.order_date
    FROM sku_models sm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON sm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= sm.order_date 
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR sm.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode component BOM
-- Start with model components and recursively expand assemblies
exploded_components AS (
    -- Base: components from model BOM
    SELECT 
        mc.order_id,
        mc.component_qty as qty,
        mc.component_id,
        mc.order_date,
        1 as level
    FROM model_components mc
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand assemblies
    SELECT 
        ec.order_id,
        ec.qty * cb.qty as qty,
        cb.child_component_id as component_id,
        ec.order_date,
        ec.level + 1
    FROM exploded_components ec
    JOIN component c ON ec.component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON c.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
      AND cb.valid_from <= ec.order_date 
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR ec.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
),
-- Get only leaf parts (non-assemblies)
parts AS (
    SELECT 
        ec.order_id,
        ec.qty,
        ec.component_id,
        ec.order_date
    FROM exploded_components ec
    JOIN component c ON ec.component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Also include model components that are already parts (not assemblies)
    SELECT 
        mc.order_id,
        mc.component_qty as qty,
        mc.component_id,
        mc.order_date
    FROM model_components mc
    JOIN component c ON mc.component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = false
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM exploded_components ec 
          WHERE ec.order_id = mc.order_id 
            AND ec.component_id = mc.component_id
            AND ec.order_date = mc.order_date
      )
),
-- Sum quantities for the specific part
part_consumption AS (

    FROM parts p
    JOIN component c ON p.component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE c.component_code = 'LEG-407-OAK-00192'
)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get the store_id for Amazon-CA-19
target_store AS (
    SELECT store_id FROM store WHERE store_name = 'Amazon-CA-19'
),

-- Get all completed orders for the target store in 2023
orders_2023 AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date
    FROM orders o
    JOIN target_store ts ON o.store_id = ts.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < '2024-01-01'
),

-- Get order lines with their SKU info
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.qty as line_qty,
        ol.unit_price,
        l.sku_id,
        s.is_bundle,
        o.order_date
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders_2023 o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON l.sku_id = s.sku_id
),

-- For bundle SKUs, explode to item SKUs
exploded_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs directly
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_qty,
        ol.sku_id,
        ol.line_qty as sku_qty,  -- qty of this SKU in the order line
        1 as bundle_multiplier,   -- not a bundle item, so multiplier is 1
        ol.order_date
    FROM order_lines ol
    WHERE ol.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs exploded to their item SKUs
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_qty,
        bi.item_sku_id as sku_id,
        bi.qty as sku_qty,        -- qty of item SKU within the bundle
        ol.line_qty as bundle_multiplier,  -- how many bundles ordered
        ol.order_date
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ol.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ol.is_bundle = true
),

-- Calculate total quantity of each SKU per order line (accounting for bundles)
sku_quantities AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        sku_id,
        sku_qty * bundle_multiplier as total_sku_qty,
        order_date
    FROM exploded_skus
),

-- Map SKUs to models
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        sq.order_id,
        sq.sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty as model_per_sku_qty,
        sq.total_sku_qty,
        sq.total_sku_qty * sm.qty as total_model_qty,
        sq.order_date
    FROM sku_quantities sq
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sq.sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Get model BOM components with validity check
model_bom_valid AS (
    SELECT 
        mb.model_id,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty as component_per_model_qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
),

-- Get all component BOMs with validity on each order date (need to check per date)
-- We'll use a CTE that joins with the order date
component_bom_valid AS (
    SELECT 
        cb.parent_component_id,
        cb.child_component_id,
        cb.qty,
        cb.valid_from,
        cb.valid_to
    FROM component_bom cb
),

-- Find the target part
target_part AS (
    SELECT component_id 
    FROM component 
    WHERE component_code = 'LEG-862-GRY-00374'
),

-- Recursive explosion: start from model components and drill down
-- We need to track the order context and accumulate quantities
exploded_components AS (
    -- Base: model BOM entries
    SELECT 
        sm.order_id,
        sm.order_date,
        sm.model_id,
        mbv.component_id,
        sm.total_model_qty * mbv.component_per_model_qty as total_qty,
        1 as level
    FROM sku_models sm
    JOIN model_bom_valid mbv ON sm.model_id = mbv.model_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: component BOM entries
    SELECT 
        ec.order_id,
        ec.order_date,
        ec.component_id as model_id,  -- parent becomes the "model" for next level
        cbv.child_component_id as component_id,
        ec.total_qty * cbv.qty as total_qty,
        ec.level + 1
    FROM exploded_components ec
    JOIN component_bom_valid cbv ON ec.component_id = cbv.parent_component_id
    WHERE cbv.valid_from <= ec.order_date
      AND (cbv.valid_to IS NULL OR ec.order_date <= cbv.valid_to)
      -- Only recurse if current component is an assembly
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM component c WHERE c.component_id = ec.component_id AND c.is_assembly = true)
)

-- Sum up all quantities for the target part
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ec.total_qty), 0) as total_consumed
FROM exploded_components ec
JOIN target_part tp ON ec.component_id = tp.component_id
JOIN component c ON ec.component_id = c.component_id
WHERE c.is_assembly = false  -- ensure it's a part (should be true for our target)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all completed orders for Amazon-CA-14 in 2024 with their order lines
store_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, ol.line_no, ol.listing_id, ol.qty as order_line_qty, ol.unit_price
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE s.store_name = 'Amazon-CA-14'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01'
),
-- Get SKU for each order line through listing
order_line_skus AS (
    SELECT so.*, l.sku_id
    FROM store_orders so
    JOIN listing l ON so.listing_id = l.listing_id
),
-- Expand bundles: for bundle SKUs, get the item SKUs with their quantities
-- For non-bundle SKUs, just pass through with qty 1
expanded_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs
    SELECT ols.order_id, ols.order_date, ols.line_no, ols.listing_id, 
           ols.order_line_qty, ols.unit_price, ols.sku_id as original_sku_id,
           ols.sku_id as resolved_sku_id, 1 as bundle_multiplier
    FROM order_line_skus ols
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ols.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs
    SELECT ols.order_id, ols.order_date, ols.line_no, ols.listing_id,
           ols.order_line_qty, ols.unit_price, ols.sku_id as original_sku_id,
           bi.item_sku_id as resolved_sku_id, bi.qty as bundle_multiplier
    FROM order_line_skus ols
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ols.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ss.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
),
-- Get models for each resolved SKU
sku_models AS (
    SELECT es.*, sm.model_id, sm.qty as model_qty
    FROM expanded_skus es
    JOIN sku_model sm ON es.resolved_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),
-- Calculate total model units needed per order line
model_units AS (
    SELECT order_id, order_date, line_no, listing_id, order_line_qty,
           model_id, bundle_multiplier * model_qty as models_per_sku_unit
    FROM sku_models
),
-- Total units of each model consumed
total_model_units AS (
    SELECT order_id, order_date, line_no, listing_id, 
           model_id, order_line_qty * models_per_sku_unit as total_model_qty
    FROM model_units
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode model BOM
model_bom_exploded AS (
    -- Base: start with models and their direct components
    SELECT tmu.order_id, tmu.order_date, tmu.line_no, tmu.listing_id,
           tmu.model_id as root_model_id, tmu.total_model_qty as model_multiplier,
           mb.component_id as parent_component_id, mb.component_id as child_component_id,
           mb.qty as qty_per_parent, tmu.total_model_qty * mb.qty as total_qty,
           1 as level
    FROM total_model_units tmu
    JOIN model_bom mb ON tmu.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= tmu.order_date 
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR tmu.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: explode assembly components
    SELECT mbe.order_id, mbe.order_date, mbe.line_no, mbe.listing_id,
           mbe.root_model_id, mbe.model_multiplier,
           cb.parent_component_id, cb.child_component_id,
           cb.qty as qty_per_parent, mbe.total_qty * cb.qty as total_qty,
           mbe.level + 1
    FROM model_bom_exploded mbe
    JOIN component c ON mbe.child_component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON c.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
      AND cb.valid_from <= mbe.order_date 
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR mbe.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
),
-- Get all leaf parts (non-assembly components)
leaf_parts AS (
    SELECT mbe.order_id, mbe.order_date, mbe.line_no, mbe.listing_id,
           mbe.root_model_id, mbe.child_component_id, mbe.total_qty
    FROM model_bom_exploded mbe
    JOIN component c ON mbe.child_component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Also include direct components that are parts (level 1, not assemblies)
    SELECT tmu.order_id, tmu.order_date, tmu.line_no, tmu.listing_id,
           tmu.model_id as root_model_id, mb.component_id as child_component_id,
           tmu.total_model_qty * mb.qty as total_qty
    FROM total_model_units tmu
    JOIN model_bom mb ON tmu.model_id = mb.model_id
    JOIN component c ON mb.component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = false
      AND mb.valid_from <= tmu.order_date 
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR tmu.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
      -- Exclude those already in model_bom_exploded (which only has assemblies at level 1)
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM model_bom_exploded mbe 
          WHERE mbe.order_id = tmu.order_id AND mbe.line_no = tmu.line_no 
            AND mbe.child_component_id = mb.component_id
      )
),
-- Find the component_id for FOO-998-OAK-02932
target_component AS (
    SELECT component_id 
    FROM component 
    WHERE component_code = 'FOO-998-OAK-02932'
),
-- Sum total consumption of target part
total_consumption AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(lp.total_qty), 0) as total_units
    FROM leaf_parts lp
    CROSS JOIN target_component tc
    WHERE lp.child_component_id = tc.component_id
)
SELECT total_units FROM total_consumption;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get the store_id for Wayfair-JP-23
target_store AS (
    SELECT store_id FROM store WHERE store_name = 'Wayfair-JP-23'
),

-- Get all completed orders from the target store in 2025
store_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date
    FROM orders o
    JOIN target_store ts ON o.store_id = ts.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
),

-- Get all order lines with their SKU and quantity
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        l.sku_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty
    FROM store_orders so
    JOIN order_line ol ON so.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
),

-- Expand bundles: for bundle SKUs, get the item SKUs with their quantities
-- For non-bundle SKUs, just pass through
expanded_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs (direct model mapping)
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.sku_id,
        ol.line_qty AS sku_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ol.sku_id = ss.sku_id AND ss.is_bundle = false
    JOIN sku_model sm ON ol.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs, then to models
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.order_date,
        bi.item_sku_id AS sku_id,
        ol.line_qty * bi.qty AS sku_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ol.sku_id = ss.sku_id AND ss.is_bundle = true
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ol.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Calculate total model units needed per order line
model_units AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        order_date,
        model_id,
        SUM(sku_qty * model_qty) AS total_model_qty
    FROM expanded_skus
    GROUP BY order_id, order_date, model_id
),

-- Get the target part component_id
target_part AS (
    SELECT component_id FROM component WHERE component_code = 'CRO-590-WAL-00508' AND is_assembly = false
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode model BOM to components
-- Start with model components
model_bom_exploded AS (
    SELECT 
        mu.order_id,
        mu.order_date,
        mu.model_id,
        mb.component_id AS child_component_id,
        mu.total_model_qty * mb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM model_units mu
    JOIN model_bom mb ON mu.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= mu.order_date 
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mu.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recurse through component BOMs
    SELECT 
        mbe.order_id,
        mbe.order_date,
        mbe.model_id,
        cb.child_component_id,
        mbe.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM model_bom_exploded mbe
    JOIN component_bom cb ON mbe.child_component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= mbe.order_date 
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR mbe.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM component c WHERE c.component_id = mbe.child_component_id AND c.is_assembly = true)
)

-- Sum up all consumed units of the target part
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0)::BIGINT AS total_consumed_units
FROM model_bom_exploded mbe
JOIN target_part tp ON mbe.child_component_id = tp.component_id;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all completed orders from Wayfair-JP-23 in 2023
wayfair_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE s.store_name = 'Wayfair-JP-23'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2023-12-31'
),

-- Get order lines with their SKUs and quantities
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        l.sku_id,
        o.order_date
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN wayfair_orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
),

-- Expand bundles: for bundle SKUs, get their item SKUs with quantities
-- Non-bundle SKUs pass through as-is with multiplier 1
expanded_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs (direct model mapping)
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_qty,
        ol.sku_id,
        ol.order_date,
        1 AS bundle_multiplier,
        ol.sku_id AS resolved_sku_id
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ol.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_qty,
        ol.sku_id,
        ol.order_date,
        bi.qty AS bundle_multiplier,
        bi.item_sku_id AS resolved_sku_id
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ol.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ss.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
),

-- Get model quantities for each resolved SKU
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        es.order_id,
        es.line_qty,
        es.bundle_multiplier,
        es.resolved_sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty_per_sku,
        es.order_date
    FROM expanded_skus es
    JOIN sku_model sm ON es.resolved_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Calculate total model units needed per order line
model_units AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        line_qty * bundle_multiplier * model_qty_per_sku AS total_model_qty,
        model_id,
        order_date
    FROM sku_models
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode component BOM
-- Start with model BOM components
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base: model BOM
    SELECT 
        mu.order_id,
        mu.total_model_qty,
        mb.component_id,
        mu.total_model_qty * mb.qty AS total_component_qty,
        mu.order_date,
        1 AS level
    FROM model_units mu
    JOIN model_bom mb ON mu.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= mu.order_date 
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mu.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: component BOM for assemblies
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.total_model_qty,
        cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
        be.total_component_qty * cb.qty AS total_component_qty,
        be.order_date,
        be.level + 1
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN component c ON be.component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON c.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
      AND cb.valid_from <= be.order_date 
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)

-- Sum up total consumption of the target part
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_component_qty), 0) AS total_units_consumed
FROM bom_explosion be
JOIN component c ON be.component_id = c.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'LEG-148-WAL-02453'
  AND c.is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
    JOIN store_orders so ON ol.order_id = so.order_id

    SELECT

        osl.line_qty,
        osl.sku_id,
        osl.order_date,
        osl.line_qty as sku_qty  -- quantity of this SKU in the order line
    FROM order_sku_lines osl
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON osl.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs
    SELECT 
        osl.order_id,
        osl.line_qty,
        bi.item_sku_id as sku_id,
        osl.order_date,
        osl.line_qty * bi.qty as sku_qty  -- bundle qty * item qty within bundle
    FROM order_sku_lines osl
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON osl.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ss.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
),

    SELECT 
        es.order_id,
        es.sku_qty * sm.qty as model_qty,  -- total quantity of models needed
        sm.model_id,
        es.order_date
    FROM expanded_skus es
    JOIN sku_model sm ON es.sku_id = sm.sku_id
),
-- Get model BOM components with validity check
model_bom_valid AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.order_id,
        sm.model_qty * mb.qty as component_qty,
        mb.component_id,
        sm.order_date
    FROM sku_models sm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON sm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= sm.order_date

        mbv.order_date,

    FROM model_bom_valid mbv

        rb.order_id,
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all order lines for completed orders in US in 2025 with their SKU quantities
order_sku_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        l.sku_id,
        SUM(ol.qty) as total_sku_qty
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.country = 'US'
      AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
    GROUP BY l.sku_id
),
-- Expand bundles: for bundle SKUs, get their item SKUs with quantities
-- For non-bundle SKUs, just pass through with qty 1
expanded_sku AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs (direct model mapping)
    SELECT 
        ss.sku_id,
        ss.sku_id as original_sku_id,
        1 as bundle_multiplier
    FROM sales_sku ss
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle items: item SKUs inside bundles
    SELECT 
        bi.item_sku_id as sku_id,
        bi.bundle_sku_id as original_sku_id,
        bi.qty as bundle_multiplier
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON bi.bundle_sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
),
-- Calculate total quantity per SKU (accounting for bundles)
sku_total_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        es.sku_id,
        SUM(osq.total_sku_qty * es.bundle_multiplier) as total_qty
    FROM expanded_sku es
    JOIN order_sku_qty osq ON es.original_sku_id = osq.sku_id
    GROUP BY es.sku_id
),
-- Map SKUs to models
sku_model_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.model_id,
        SUM(stq.total_qty * sm.qty) as model_total_qty
    FROM sku_total_qty stq
    JOIN sku_model sm ON stq.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    GROUP BY sm.model_id
)
SELECT cm.model_code
FROM sku_model_qty smq
JOIN company_model cm ON smq.model_id = cm.model_id
ORDER BY smq.model_total_qty DESC
LIMIT 3
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all SKUs and their model mappings, including bundle expansion
sku_models AS (
    -- Direct model mappings for non-bundle SKUs
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN sku_model sm ON s.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle items: the item SKU maps to models, multiplied by bundle qty
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id AS sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty * bi.qty AS model_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),
-- Get completed order lines with their country and date, expanded to models
order_model_units AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.model_id,
        ol.qty * sm.model_qty AS total_model_units
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN store st ON l.store_id = st.store_id
    JOIN sku_models sm ON l.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND st.country = 'DE'
      AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT cm.model_code
FROM order_model_units omu
JOIN company_model cm ON omu.model_id = cm.model_id
GROUP BY cm.model_id, cm.model_code
ORDER BY SUM(omu.total_model_units) DESC
LIMIT 3
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all completed orders in CA in 2024
ca_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.country = 'CA'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
),

-- Get order lines with their SKU quantities
order_sku_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        l.sku_id
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN ca_orders co ON ol.order_id = co.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
),

-- For non-bundle SKUs: direct model mapping
-- For bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs first
sku_to_models AS (
    -- Direct model mappings (non-bundle SKUs that map directly to models)
    SELECT 
        sm.sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sku_model sm
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle items: bundle SKU -> item SKU -> models
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id AS sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        bi.qty * sm.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Calculate total model units sold
model_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        stm.model_id,
        SUM(osq.line_qty * stm.model_qty_per_sku) AS total_units
    FROM order_sku_qty osq
    JOIN sku_to_models stm ON osq.sku_id = stm.sku_id
    GROUP BY stm.model_id
)

SELECT cm.model_code
FROM model_sales ms
JOIN company_model cm ON ms.model_id = cm.model_id
ORDER BY ms.total_units DESC
LIMIT 3
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, expand bundle SKUs to their item SKUs
bundle_expansion AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs: map directly to themselves with qty 1
    SELECT sku_id AS original_sku_id, sku_id AS item_sku_id, 1 AS bundle_qty
    FROM sales_sku
    WHERE is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: expand to their items
    SELECT bi.bundle_sku_id AS original_sku_id, bi.item_sku_id, bi.qty AS bundle_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ss.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
),
-- Map SKUs to models with quantities
sku_to_model AS (
    SELECT 
        be.original_sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        be.bundle_qty * sm.qty AS total_model_qty_per_sku
    FROM bundle_expansion be
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = be.item_sku_id
),
-- Get all order lines with their SKU and model info
order_lines_with_models AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        stm.model_id,
        stm.total_model_qty_per_sku,
        ol.qty * stm.total_model_qty_per_sku AS model_units
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN sku_to_model stm ON stm.original_sku_id = l.sku_id
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN store s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.country = 'JP'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
)
SELECT cm.model_code
FROM order_lines_with_models olm
JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_id = olm.model_id
GROUP BY cm.model_id, cm.model_code
ORDER BY SUM(olm.model_units) DESC
LIMIT 3
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Find the store_id for Amazon-DE-01
target_store AS (
    SELECT store_id FROM store WHERE store_name = 'Amazon-DE-01'
),

-- Find the part_id for CAB-856-BLK-00745
target_part AS (
    SELECT component_id AS part_id FROM component WHERE component_code = 'CAB-856-BLK-00745' AND is_assembly = false
),

-- Get completed orders from target store in 2024
store_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date
    FROM orders o
    JOIN target_store ts ON o.store_id = ts.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
),

-- Order lines with SKU info
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        ol.unit_price,
        l.sku_id,
        s.is_bundle,
        s.sku_code,
        so.order_date
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN store_orders so ON ol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON l.sku_id = s.sku_id
),

-- Expand bundles: for bundle SKUs, get item SKUs; for non-bundles, keep as-is
expanded_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs directly
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.line_qty,
        ol.sku_id AS item_sku_id,
        ol.line_qty AS sku_qty,
        ol.order_date
    FROM order_lines ol
    WHERE ol.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs expanded to item SKUs
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.line_qty,
        bi.item_sku_id,
        ol.line_qty * bi.qty AS sku_qty,
        ol.order_date
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ol.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ol.is_bundle = true
),

-- Map SKUs to models
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        es.order_id,
        es.line_no,
        es.line_qty,
        es.sku_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_per_sku_qty,
        es.order_date,
        es.sku_qty * sm.qty AS total_model_qty
    FROM expanded_skus es
    JOIN sku_model sm ON es.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Get model BOM components (top-level components for each model)
model_bom_components AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.order_id,
        sm.line_no,
        sm.total_model_qty,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty AS component_qty,
        sm.order_date,
        sm.total_model_qty * mb.qty AS total_component_qty
    FROM sku_models sm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON sm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= sm.order_date AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR sm.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
),

-- Recursive explosion of component BOM
component_explosion AS (
    -- Base: start with model BOM components
    SELECT 
        mbc.order_id,
        mbc.line_no,
        mbc.component_id,
        mbc.total_component_qty AS qty,
        mbc.order_date,
        c.is_assembly
    FROM model_bom_components mbc
    JOIN component c ON mbc.component_id = c.component_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: explode assemblies
    SELECT 
        ce.order_id,
        ce.line_no,
        cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
        ce.qty * cb.qty AS qty,
        ce.order_date,
        c.is_assembly
    FROM component_explosion ce
    JOIN component_bom cb ON ce.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    JOIN component c ON cb.child_component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE ce.is_assembly = true
      AND cb.valid_from <= ce.order_date AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR ce.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)

-- Sum quantities for the target part
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ce.qty), 0) AS total_consumed
FROM component_explosion ce
JOIN target_part tp ON ce.component_id = tp.part_id
WHERE ce.is_assembly = false;
```
