```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all completed orders for Amazon-CA-14 in 2024 with their lines
store_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.order_date,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS order_line_qty,
        ol.unit_price,
        l.sku_id
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE s.store_name = 'Amazon-CA-14'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01'
),

-- Expand bundles: get the underlying item SKUs and their quantities
-- For non-bundles, this just passes through with qty 1
-- For bundles, we expand to item SKUs
expanded_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs directly
    SELECT 
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        so.line_no,
        so.listing_id,
        so.order_line_qty,
        so.sku_id AS original_sku_id,
        so.sku_id AS resolved_sku_id,
        so.order_line_qty AS sku_qty  -- qty of this SKU in the order line
    FROM store_orders so
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON so.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs
    SELECT 
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        so.line_no,
        so.listing_id,
        so.order_line_qty,
        so.sku_id AS original_sku_id,
        bi.item_sku_id AS resolved_sku_id,
        so.order_line_qty * bi.qty AS sku_qty  -- bundle qty * item qty within bundle
    FROM store_orders so
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON so.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ss.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
),

-- Get model quantities for each resolved SKU
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        es.order_id,
        es.order_date,
        es.line_no,
        es.listing_id,
        es.original_sku_id,
        es.resolved_sku_id,
        es.sku_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_per_sku_qty,
        es.sku_qty * sm.qty AS total_model_qty
    FROM expanded_skus es
    JOIN sku_model sm ON es.resolved_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Recursive BOM expansion for model BOM (model -> components)
model_bom_recursive AS (
    -- Base: models to their direct components
    SELECT 
        sm.order_id,
        sm.order_date,
        sm.line_no,
        sm.listing_id,
        sm.original_sku_id,
        sm.resolved_sku_id,
        sm.sku_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.total_model_qty,
        mb.component_id AS child_component_id,
        CAST(mb.qty AS DOUBLE) AS bom_qty,
        sm.total_model_qty * mb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM sku_models sm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON sm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= sm.order_date
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR sm.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: component BOM expansion
    SELECT 
        mbr.order_id,
        mbr.order_date,
        mbr.line_no,
        mbr.listing_id,
        mbr.original_sku_id,
        mbr.resolved_sku_id,
        mbr.sku_qty,
        mbr.model_id,
        mbr.total_model_qty,
        cb.child_component_id,
        CAST(cb.qty AS DOUBLE) AS bom_qty,
        mbr.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM model_bom_recursive mbr
    JOIN component_bom cb ON mbr.child_component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= mbr.order_date
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR mbr.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
),

-- Get all leaf parts (non-assembly components) from the recursive expansion
all_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        mbr.*,
        c.component_code,
        c.name,
        c.is_assembly
    FROM model_bom_recursive mbr
    JOIN component c ON mbr.child_component_id = c.component_id
),

-- Filter to only parts (non-assembly)
leaf_parts AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM all_parts
    WHERE is_assembly = false
)

-- Sum up total consumption of MOT-228-WAL-00998
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) AS total_units_consumed
FROM leaf_parts
WHERE component_code = 'MOT-228-WAL-00998'
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE

-- First, get all SKUs with their effective model quantities
-- For non-bundle SKUs: direct model mapping
-- For bundle SKUs: need to expand to item SKUs first

-- Base: direct SKU -> model relationships (non-bundle SKUs)
sku_model_direct AS (
    SELECT sm.sku_id, sm.model_id, sm.qty as model_qty
    FROM sku_model sm
    JOIN sales_sku s ON sm.sku_id = s.sku_id
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
),

-- Bundle expansion: bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model
bundle_expanded AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id as sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        bi.qty * sm.qty as model_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- All SKU -> model relationships
all_sku_models AS (
    SELECT * FROM sku_model_direct
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM bundle_expanded
),

-- Get completed orders in DE in 2023 with their line quantities

    SELECT 
        ol.listing_id,

    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
```

```sql
    -- Non-bundle SKUs directly map to models
    SELECT

        model_id,
        qty as model_qty
    FROM sku_model
    
    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id as sku_id,
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, expand bundle SKUs to their item SKUs
bundle_expansion AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs map directly to themselves
    SELECT sku_id AS original_sku_id, sku_id AS resolved_sku_id, 1 AS bundle_multiplier
    FROM sales_sku
    WHERE is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs expand to their item SKUs
    SELECT bi.bundle_sku_id AS original_sku_id, bi.item_sku_id AS resolved_sku_id, bi.qty AS bundle_multiplier
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ss.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
),
-- Handle nested bundles by recursive expansion
bundle_recursive AS (
    SELECT * FROM bundle_expansion
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT br.original_sku_id, be.resolved_sku_id, br.bundle_multiplier * be.bundle_multiplier
    FROM bundle_recursive br
    JOIN bundle_expansion be ON be.original_sku_id = br.resolved_sku_id
    WHERE be.original_sku_id != be.resolved_sku_id  -- avoid infinite loop on non-bundles
),
-- Get final resolved SKUs with multipliers (deduplicate by taking max path or use distinct)
resolved_skus AS (
    SELECT original_sku_id, resolved_sku_id, MAX(bundle_multiplier) AS bundle_multiplier
    FROM bundle_recursive
    GROUP BY original_sku_id, resolved_sku_id
),
-- Get model quantities per resolved SKU
sku_models AS (
    SELECT sm.sku_id, sm.model_id, sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM sku_model sm
),
-- Join order lines to listings to stores, then resolve bundles and map to models
order_model_units AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.model_id,
        ol.qty * COALESCE(rs.bundle_multiplier, 1) * sm.model_qty AS total_model_units
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN store s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
    LEFT JOIN resolved_skus rs ON rs.original_sku_id = l.sku_id
    JOIN sku_models sm ON sm.sku_id = COALESCE(rs.resolved_sku_id, l.sku_id)
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.country = 'JP'
      AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT cm.model_code
FROM order_model_units omu
JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_id = omu.model_id
GROUP BY cm.model_id, cm.model_code
ORDER BY SUM(omu.total_model_units) DESC
LIMIT 3
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all completed orders in CA in 2023
ca_orders_2023 AS (
    SELECT o.order_id
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE s.country = 'CA'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2023-12-31'
),

-- Get all order lines for these orders with their SKU and quantity
order_sku_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        l.sku_id
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN ca_orders_2023 co ON ol.order_id = co.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
),

-- Calculate SKU-level quantities sold
sku_sold_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        sku_id,
        SUM(line_qty) AS total_sku_qty
    FROM (
        SELECT sku_id, line_qty FROM order_sku_qty
    )
    GROUP BY sku_id
),

-- For bundle SKUs, expand to item SKUs with quantities
-- First get direct item SKUs from bundles
bundle_expansion AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs: map directly to their models
    SELECT 
        ss.sku_id,
        ss.sku_id AS original_sku_id,
        1 AS bundle_multiplier,
        ss.is_bundle
    FROM sales_sku ss
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs
    SELECT 
        bi.item_sku_id AS sku_id,
        ss.sku_id AS original_sku_id,
        bi.qty AS bundle_multiplier,
        ss.is_bundle
    FROM sales_sku ss
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ss.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
),

-- Calculate model quantities from SKUs
sku_model_qty AS (
    -- Direct model mapping for non-bundle SKUs
    SELECT 
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_per_sku_qty
    FROM sku_model sm
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON sm.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- For bundle items, they map to models too
    SELECT 
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_per_sku_qty
    FROM sku_model sm
    JOIN bundle_expansion be ON sm.sku_id = be.sku_id
    WHERE be.is_bundle = true  -- This came from a bundle expansion
),

-- Now combine: for each original SKU sold, find its models
-- Need to trace: sold SKU -> if bundle, expand to items -> items map to models
sold_sku_to_model AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs sold
    SELECT 
        ssq.sku_id AS original_sku_id,
        ssq.sku_id AS effective_sku_id,
        1 AS bundle_qty,
        ssq.total_sku_qty AS sku_sold_qty
    FROM sku_sold_qty ssq
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ssq.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs sold: expand
    SELECT 
        ssq.sku_id AS original_sku_id,
        bi.item_sku_id AS effective_sku_id,
        bi.qty AS bundle_qty,
        ssq.total_sku_qty AS sku_sold_qty
    FROM sku_sold_qty ssq
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ssq.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ssq.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
),

-- Map effective SKUs to models
model_units AS (
    SELECT 
        ssm.original_sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        ssm.sku_sold_qty * ssm.bundle_qty * sm.qty AS total_model_units
    FROM sold_sku_to_model ssm
    JOIN sku_model sm ON ssm.effective_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Aggregate by model
model_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        model_id,
        SUM(total_model_units) AS total_units
    FROM model_units
    GROUP BY model_id
)

SELECT cm.model_code
FROM model_totals mt
JOIN company_model cm ON mt.model_id = cm.model_id
ORDER BY mt.total_units DESC
LIMIT 3;
```

```sql
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2023-05-22')
),

exploded_parts AS (
    -- Base case: direct components from model BOM that are parts
    SELECT 
        mc.component_id,
        mc.qty as total_qty
    FROM model_components mc
    JOIN component c ON mc.component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base case: direct components from model BOM that are assemblies

        cb.child_component_id as component_id,

      AND cb.valid_from <= DATE '2023-05-22'

    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: expand assemblies further down

        cb.child_component_id as component_id,
        ep.total_qty * cb.qty as total_qty

    JOIN component c ON ep.component_id = c.component_id
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Find the model_id for the given model code
target_model AS (
    SELECT model_id, model_code
    FROM company_model
    WHERE model_code = 'VI5-180WHT63-0257'
),
-- Recursive BOM explosion: start from model -> components, then follow assembly -> components
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: model directly maps to components
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS component_code,
        c.qty AS total_qty
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN target_model m ON c.parent_kind = 'model' AND c.parent_code = m.model_code
    WHERE c.child_kind = 'component'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: assembly components map to child components
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS component_code,
        be.total_qty * c.qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN component comp ON comp.component_code = be.component_code
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'component' AND c.parent_code = be.component_code
    WHERE comp.is_assembly = true
      AND c.child_kind = 'component'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
-- Sum up costs for all parts (non-assembly components)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(be.total_qty * comp.unit_cost), 2) AS total_parts_cost
FROM bom_explosion be
JOIN component comp ON comp.component_code = be.component_code
WHERE comp.is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find all item SKUs in the bundle BDL-JP-0043 with their quantities
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT child_code AS sku_code, qty AS sku_qty
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'sku' AND parent_code = 'BDL-JP-0043'
      AND child_kind = 'sku'
      AND valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
),
-- Map item SKUs to company models
sku_to_models AS (
    SELECT bi.sku_code, bi.sku_qty, uc.child_code AS model_code, uc.qty AS model_per_sku_qty
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' AND uc.parent_code = bi.sku_code
                         AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
                         AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode model -> components -> sub-assemblies -> parts
model_bom AS (
    -- Base: models to their direct components
    SELECT 
        sm.sku_code,
        sm.sku_qty,
        sm.model_code,
        sm.model_per_sku_qty,
        uc.child_code AS component_code,
        uc.qty AS component_qty,
        sm.sku_qty * sm.model_per_sku_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM sku_to_models sm
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'model' AND uc.parent_code = sm.model_code
                         AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
                         AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: assemblies to their child components
    SELECT 
        mb.sku_code,
        mb.sku_qty,
        mb.model_code,
        mb.model_per_sku_qty,
        uc.child_code AS component_code,
        uc.qty AS component_qty,
        mb.total_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN component c ON c.component_code = mb.component_code
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'component' AND uc.parent_code = mb.component_code
                         AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
                         AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
)
-- Sum total quantity of the target part across all paths
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) AS total_part_qty
FROM model_bom mb
JOIN component c ON c.component_code = mb.component_code
WHERE c.component_code = 'CAB-747-WHT-02876' AND c.is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
    -- Start from the bundle SKU, find its direct children (item SKUs)
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS current_code,
        c.child_kind AS current_kind,
        c.qty AS path_qty,

      AND c.child_kind = 'sku'
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find all item SKUs that map to the target model SW6-120GRY13-0789
item_skus_for_model AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.parent_code AS sku_code
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN sales_sku s ON c.parent_code = s.sku_code
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.child_kind = 'model'
      AND c.child_code = 'SW6-120GRY13-0789'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= c.valid_to)
      AND s.is_bundle = false
),
-- Find all bundle SKUs that contain those item SKUs directly or transitively through other bundles
bundle_containing_item AS (
    -- Direct: bundle SKU -> item SKU
    SELECT DISTINCT c.parent_code AS bundle_sku_code
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN sales_sku s ON c.parent_code = s.sku_code
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.child_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.child_code IN (SELECT sku_code FROM item_skus_for_model)
      AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= c.valid_to)
      AND s.is_bundle = true
    
    UNION
    
    -- Recursive: bundle SKU -> another bundle SKU that eventually contains the item SKU
    SELECT DISTINCT c.parent_code AS bundle_sku_code
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN sales_sku s ON c.parent_code = s.sku_code
    JOIN bundle_containing_item bci ON c.child_code = bci.bundle_sku_code
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.child_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= c.valid_to)
      AND s.is_bundle = true
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bundle_sku_code) FROM bundle_containing_item
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bundle_models AS (
    -- Start with all bundle SKUs
    SELECT 
        s.sku_code as bundle_sku_code,
        s.sku_code as current_sku_code,
        s.is_bundle,
        1 as depth
    FROM sales_sku s
    WHERE s.is_bundle = true
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively expand: bundle SKU -> item SKU(s)
    SELECT 
        bm.bundle_sku_code,
        uc.child_code as current_sku_code,
        ss.is_bundle,
        bm.depth + 1
    FROM bundle_models bm
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.parent_code = bm.current_sku_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' 
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ss.sku_code = uc.child_code
    WHERE bm.depth < 10  -- safety limit
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Continue expanding if we hit nested bundles (item SKU is also a bundle)
    SELECT 
        bm.bundle_sku_code,
        uc.child_code as current_sku_code,
        ss.is_bundle,
        bm.depth + 1
    FROM bundle_models bm
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.parent_code = bm.current_sku_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' 
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ss.sku_code = uc.child_code
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
        AND bm.depth < 10
),
-- Get leaf item SKUs (non-bundle) from each bundle
leaf_items AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT bundle_sku_code, current_sku_code as item_sku_code
    FROM bundle_models
    WHERE is_bundle = false
),
-- Map item SKUs to models
item_models AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT li.bundle_sku_code, uc.child_code as model_code
    FROM leaf_items li
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.parent_code = li.item_sku_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
        AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' 
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bundle_sku_code) as bundle_count
FROM item_models
WHERE model_code = 'NO5-120WHT83-0374';
```

```sql
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = b.sku_code
        AND c.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND c.valid_from <= '2025-12-31' AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2025-01-01')

bundle_sku_models AS (

        AND c.valid_from <= '2025-12-31' AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2025-01-01')
),

-- All SKU -> model paths with total quantity
sku_model_paths AS (
    -- Direct paths
    SELECT 
        sku_id,
        sku_code,
        model_code,
        model_qty as total_model_qty
    FROM direct_sku_models
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle paths: bundle_qty * item_qty * model_qty
    -- But we need the actual order line qty, so we just store the multiplier
    SELECT 
        bsm.bundle_sku_id as sku_id,
        bsm.bundle_sku_code as sku_code,
        bsm.model_code,
        bsm.item_qty * bsm.direct_model_qty as total_model_qty
    FROM bundle_sku_models bsm

        AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'

)
```

```sql
-- First, find all SKUs (both direct and inside bundles) that map to model NO5-140OAK03-0391
-- We need to trace: bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model, or non-bundle SKU -> model

-- Step 1: Find direct SKU -> model mappings
direct_sku_model AS (
    SELECT 
        s.sku_code,
        s.sku_id,
        s.is_bundle,
        u.qty as model_qty
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition u ON u.parent_kind = 'sku' AND u.parent_code = s.sku_code
        AND u.child_kind = 'model' AND u.child_code = 'NO5-140OAK03-0391'
    WHERE u.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (u.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= u.valid_to)
),

-- Step 2: Find bundle SKUs and their item SKUs that map to the model
-- Item SKUs inside bundles that map directly to the model
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT 
        b.sku_code as bundle_sku_code,
        b.sku_id as bundle_sku_id,
        i.sku_code as item_sku_code,
        i.sku_id as item_sku_id,
        ub.qty as bundle_item_qty,
        um.qty as model_qty
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN u_composition ub ON ub.parent_kind = 'sku' AND ub.parent_code = b.sku_code
        AND ub.child_kind = 'sku'
    JOIN sales_sku i ON i.sku_code = ub.child_code
    JOIN u_composition um ON um.parent_kind = 'sku' AND um.parent_code = i.sku_code
        AND um.child_kind = 'model' AND um.child_code = 'NO5-140OAK03-0391'
    WHERE b.is_bundle = true
        AND ub.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (ub.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= ub.valid_to)
        AND um.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (um.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= um.valid_to)
),

-- All SKUs that contribute to the model, with their multiplier to get model units
all_contributing_skus AS (
    -- Direct mappings: sku_qty * model_qty = model units
    SELECT 
        sku_id,
        sku_code,
        model_qty as multiplier
    FROM direct_sku_model
    WHERE is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle items: bundle_qty * item_qty * model_qty, but we need order line qty for bundle
    -- Actually we need to trace at order level, so we keep bundle sku with total multiplier
    SELECT 
        bundle_sku_id as sku_id,
        bundle_sku_code as sku_code,
        (bundle_item_qty * model_qty) as multiplier
    FROM bundle_items
),

-- Aggregate multipliers per SKU (in case multiple paths)
sku_multipliers AS (
    SELECT 
        sku_id,
        sku_code,
        SUM(multiplier) as total_multiplier
    FROM all_contributing_skus
    GROUP BY sku_id, sku_code
),

-- Get all completed orders in 2023
completed_orders_2023 AS (
    SELECT o.order_id
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
        AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2023-12-31'
),

-- Get order lines for these orders that match our SKUs
relevant_order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.qty,
        ol.listing_id,
        l.sku_id,
        sm.total_multiplier
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN completed_orders_2023 co ON co.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN sku_multipliers sm ON sm.sku_id = l.sku_id
)

SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(qty * total_multiplier), 0)::BIGINT as total_model_units_sold
FROM relevant_order_lines
```

```sql
    JOIN completed_orders_2023 co ON ol.order_id = co.order_id
),

-- Get all listings with their SKUs
listings_with_skus AS (
    SELECT l.listing_id, l.sku_id, s.sku_code, s.is_bundle
    FROM listing l
    JOIN sales_sku s ON l.sku_id = s.sku_id
),

-- For non-bundle SKUs, get direct model mappings
direct_sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        lws.listing_id,
        lws.sku_code,
        lws.is_bundle,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS model_qty
    FROM listings_with_skus lws
    JOIN u_composition uc ON lws.sku_code = uc.parent_code 
        AND uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
    WHERE lws.is_bundle = false
    -- SKU edges are always valid (1900-01-01 to NULL)
),

-- For bundle SKUs, get the item SKUs they contain
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT 
        lws.listing_id,
        lws.sku_code AS bundle_sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS item_sku_code,
        uc.qty AS item_qty
    FROM listings_with_skus lws
    JOIN u_composition uc ON lws.sku_code = uc.parent_code 
        AND uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
    WHERE lws.is_bundle = true
    -- SKU edges are always valid
),

-- Get model mappings for item SKUs inside bundles
bundle_item_models AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.listing_id,
        bi.bundle_sku_code,
        bi.item_sku_code,
        bi.item_qty,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS model_per_item_qty
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN u_composition uc ON bi.item_sku_code = uc.parent_code 
        AND uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
    -- SKU edges are always valid
),

-- Combine all (listing, model) pairs with their multipliers
all_listing_models AS (
    -- Direct mappings: qty = 1 * model_qty = model_qty
    SELECT 
        listing_id,
        model_code,
        model_qty AS multiplier
    FROM direct_sku_models
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle mappings: qty = item_qty * model_per_item_qty
    SELECT 
        listing_id,
        model_code,
        (item_qty * model_per_item_qty) AS multiplier
    FROM bundle_item_models
),

-- Join with order lines to get total units sold per model
model_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        alm.model_code,
        SUM(ol.qty * alm.multiplier) AS total_units
    FROM all_listing_models alm
    JOIN order_lines ol ON alm.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    WHERE alm.model_code = 'ER6-120GRY30-0515'
    GROUP BY alm.model_code
)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_units), 0) AS units_sold
FROM model_sales;
```

```sql
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        c.qty AS sku_model_qty,
        c.qty AS total_qty_to_model,
        0 AS depth
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = s.sku_code

    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle items: bundle SKU -> item SKU -> ... -> model
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        c.qty * sm.sku_model_qty AS sku_model_qty,
        c.qty * sm.total_qty_to_model AS total_qty_to_model,
        sm.depth + 1
    FROM sales_sku s
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE

-- First, get all order lines from completed orders in 2025 with their SKU codes
order_lines_2025 AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        l.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        s.is_bundle
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON l.sku_id = s.sku_id
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
),

-- Recursive expansion: start from SKUs and follow composition edges to find all paths to model VI1-140WHT65-0259
-- We need to expand: bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model, or non-bundle SKU -> model
-- Then from model -> component (but we stop at model since we want model-level sales)

-- Step 1: Find direct SKU to model mappings (for non-bundle SKUs)
-- Step 2: Find bundle SKU to item SKU mappings, then item SKU to model

-- Get all composition edges that are valid as of 2026-10-01 (for current BOM structure)
valid_edges AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
),

-- Recursive expansion from SKUs down to models and components
-- We track: starting_sku_code, current_kind, current_code, qty_multiplier
sku_expansion AS (
    -- Base: start from each SKU sold in 2025
    SELECT 
        ol.sku_code AS starting_sku_code,
        'sku'::VARCHAR AS current_kind,
        ol.sku_code AS current_code,
        ol.line_qty AS qty_multiplier,
        ol.is_bundle
    FROM order_lines_2025 ol
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: follow composition edges
    SELECT 
        se.starting_sku_code,
        ve.child_kind AS current_kind,
        ve.child_code AS current_code,
        se.qty_multiplier * ve.qty AS qty_multiplier,
        se.is_bundle
    FROM sku_expansion se
    JOIN valid_edges ve 
        ON se.current_kind = ve.parent_kind 
       AND se.current_code = ve.parent_code
    WHERE se.current_kind != 'component'  -- Stop at components (but we actually want to stop at model level)
       OR (se.current_kind = 'component' AND EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM component c 
           WHERE c.component_code = se.current_code AND c.is_assembly = true
       ))
),

-- Get all paths that reach our target model
model_paths AS (
    SELECT 
        starting_sku_code,
        qty_multiplier
    FROM sku_expansion
    WHERE current_kind = 'model' 
      AND current_code = 'VI1-140WHT65-0259'
)

-- Sum up all units sold of this model
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty_multiplier), 0)::BIGINT AS total_units_sold
FROM model_paths;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find all SKUs that directly or indirectly map to model AL9-120BLK52-0634
model_to_sku AS (
    -- Direct mapping: non-bundle SKU -> model
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        s.is_bundle,
        1 AS model_qty_per_sku  -- qty from u_composition for sku->model
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.parent_code = s.sku_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
        AND uc.child_code = 'AL9-120BLK52-0634'
        AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' 
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= uc.valid_to)
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle items: bundle SKU -> item SKU, then item SKU maps to model
    SELECT 
        s_parent.sku_id,
        s_parent.sku_code,
        s_parent.is_bundle,
        uc_bundle.qty * uc_model.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sales_sku s_parent
    JOIN u_composition uc_bundle ON uc_bundle.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc_bundle.parent_code = s_parent.sku_code
        AND uc_bundle.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc_bundle.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' 
        AND (uc_bundle.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= uc_bundle.valid_to)
    JOIN sales_sku s_child ON s_child.sku_code = uc_bundle.child_code
    JOIN u_composition uc_model ON uc_model.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc_model.parent_code = s_child.sku_code
        AND uc_model.child_kind = 'model'
        AND uc_model.child_code = 'AL9-120BLK52-0634'
        AND uc_model.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' 
        AND (uc_model.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= uc_model.valid_to)
    WHERE s_parent.is_bundle = true
)

-- Calculate total units sold
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ol.qty * m.model_qty_per_sku), 0)::BIGINT AS total_units_sold
FROM orders o
JOIN order_line ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
JOIN model_to_sku m ON m.sku_id = l.sku_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' 
    AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE

-- First, get all order lines from completed orders at Wayfair-US-05 in 2023
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS order_line_qty,
        ol.unit_price,
        o.order_date,
        l.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        s.is_bundle
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON l.sku_id = s.sku_id
    JOIN store st ON l.store_id = st.store_id
    WHERE st.store_name = 'Wayfair-US-05'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < '2024-01-01'
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode BOM for each order line
-- We track: order_id, line_no, current item kind/code, qty per parent, depth
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: start from SKU level
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.order_line_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        -- The SKU itself as starting point
        'sku' AS item_kind,
        ol.sku_code AS item_code,
        ol.order_line_qty AS total_qty,  -- qty of this item in the order line
        1 AS depth
    FROM order_lines ol
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand compositions
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.line_no,
        be.order_line_qty,
        be.order_date,
        uc.child_kind AS item_kind,
        uc.child_code AS item_code,
        be.total_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty,
        be.depth + 1
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_kind = be.item_kind 
       AND uc.parent_code = be.item_code
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= be.order_date
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
),

-- Get all component-level items (kind = 'component') and their details
component_usage AS (
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.line_no,
        be.order_line_qty,
        be.order_date,
        be.item_code AS component_code,
        be.total_qty AS consumed_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    WHERE be.item_kind = 'component'
),

-- Filter to only parts (non-assembly components) that match MOT-147-BLK-00200
target_part_usage AS (
    SELECT 
        cu.*,
        c.is_assembly
    FROM component_usage cu
    JOIN component c ON cu.component_code = c.component_code
    WHERE c.component_code = 'MOT-147-BLK-00200'
      AND c.is_assembly = false
)

-- Sum total consumed quantity
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(consumed_qty), 0) AS total_consumed_units
FROM target_part_usage
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all completed orders for Shopify-CA-09 in 2023
store_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE s.store_name = 'Shopify-CA-09'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2023-12-31'
),

-- Get order lines with their SKUs and quantities
order_sku_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        sk.sku_id,
        sk.sku_code,
        sk.is_bundle,
        so.order_date
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON l.sku_id = sk.sku_id
    JOIN store_orders so ON ol.order_id = so.order_id
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode compositions
-- We track: the original order line, the current item, its kind, code, and cumulative quantity
exploded AS (
    -- Base case: start from SKU order lines
    SELECT 
        osl.order_id,
        osl.line_qty,
        osl.order_date,
        osl.sku_code AS root_sku_code,
        'sku'::VARCHAR AS current_kind,
        osl.sku_code AS current_code,
        osl.line_qty AS cumulative_qty
    FROM order_sku_lines osl
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand current item to its children
    SELECT 
        e.order_id,
        e.line_qty,
        e.order_date,
        e.root_sku_code,
        c.child_kind AS current_kind,
        c.child_code AS current_code,
        e.cumulative_qty * c.qty AS cumulative_qty
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN u_composition c 
        ON e.current_kind = c.parent_kind 
       AND e.current_code = c.parent_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= e.order_date 
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR e.order_date <= c.valid_to)
),

-- Get leaf components (parts, not assemblies)
leaf_components AS (
    SELECT 
        e.order_id,
        e.root_sku_code,
        e.current_code AS component_code,
        e.cumulative_qty AS total_qty
    FROM exploded e
    WHERE e.current_kind = 'component'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          -- This is a leaf if it's not a parent in any valid composition on this date
          SELECT 1 
          FROM u_composition c2 
          WHERE c2.parent_kind = 'component' 
            AND c2.parent_code = e.current_code
            AND c2.valid_from <= e.order_date 
            AND (c2.valid_to IS NULL OR e.order_date <= c2.valid_to)
      )
    -- Also need to ensure it's actually a part (is_assembly = false)
    -- But we need to join with component table
),

-- Join with component table to filter parts and get the specific part
part_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        lc.order_id,
        lc.root_sku_code,
        lc.component_code,
        lc.total_qty
    FROM leaf_components lc
    JOIN component comp ON lc.component_code = comp.component_code
    WHERE comp.component_code = 'FAS-427-GRY-01954'
      AND comp.is_assembly = false
)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE

-- First, get all order lines for completed orders in store Amazon-CA-19 in 2023
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS order_line_qty,
        ol.unit_price,
        o.order_date,
        l.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        s.is_bundle
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON l.sku_id = s.sku_id
    JOIN store st ON l.store_id = st.store_id
    WHERE st.store_name = 'Amazon-CA-19'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2023-12-31'
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode BOM for each order line
-- We track: the original order line, the current item being expanded, its kind, code, and accumulated quantity
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: start from SKU level
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.order_line_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.sku_code AS root_sku_code,
        'sku' AS item_kind,
        ol.sku_code AS item_code,
        1 AS qty_per_unit,  -- 1 unit of the SKU itself
        ol.order_line_qty AS total_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand according to composition edges valid on order_date
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.line_no,
        be.order_line_qty,
        be.order_date,
        be.root_sku_code,
        uc.child_kind AS item_kind,
        uc.child_code AS item_code,
        be.qty_per_unit * uc.qty AS qty_per_unit,
        be.order_line_qty * be.qty_per_unit * uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON be.item_kind = uc.parent_kind 
        AND be.item_code = uc.parent_code
        AND uc.valid_from <= be.order_date 
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
),

-- Get all component-level items and their paths to parts
-- We need to continue expanding assemblies until we reach parts
-- First, let's identify all paths and filter to final parts
all_expanded AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        line_no,
        order_line_qty,
        order_date,
        root_sku_code,
        item_kind,
        item_code,
        qty_per_unit,
        total_qty
    FROM bom_explosion
),

-- Continue expanding assemblies to parts
-- We need another recursive CTE for assembly -> component expansion
assembly_explosion AS (
    -- Start from components found in bom_explosion
    SELECT 
        ae.order_id,
        ae.line_no,
        ae.order_line_qty,
        ae.order_date,
        ae.root_sku_code,
        ae.item_kind,
        ae.item_code,
        ae.qty_per_unit,
        ae.total_qty,
        c.is_assembly
    FROM all_expanded ae
    LEFT JOIN component c ON ae.item_code = c.component_code AND ae.item_kind = 'component'
    WHERE ae.item_kind = 'component'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand assemblies
    SELECT 
        ae.order_id,
        ae.line_no,
        ae.order_line_qty,
        ae.order_date,
        ae.root_sku_code,
        uc.child_kind AS item_kind,
        uc.child_code AS item_code,
        ae.qty_per_unit * uc.qty AS qty_per_unit,
        ae.order_line_qty * ae.qty_per_unit * uc.qty AS total_qty,
        c2.is_assembly
    FROM assembly_explosion ae
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON ae.item_kind = uc.parent_kind 
        AND ae.item_code = uc.parent_code
        AND uc.valid_from <= ae.order_date 
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR ae.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    LEFT JOIN component c2 ON uc.child_code = c2.component_code AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
    WHERE ae.is_assembly = true
),

-- Combine non-assembly components from first expansion with fully expanded assemblies
final_parts AS (
    -- Parts from bom_explosion that are not assemblies (or not components)
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        line_no,
        order_line_qty,
        order_date,
        root_sku_code,
        item_kind,
        item_code,
        qty_per_unit,
        total_qty
    FROM all_expanded ae
    WHERE ae.item_kind != 'component'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts from assembly explosion (non-assembly components)
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        line_no,
        order_line_qty,
        order_date,
        root_sku_code,
        item_kind,
        item_code,
        qty_per_unit,
        total_qty
    FROM assembly_explosion
    WHERE is_assembly = false OR is_assembly IS NULL
)

-- Sum total quantity for part LEG-862-GRY-00374
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) AS total_consumed
FROM final_parts
WHERE item_code = 'LEG-862-GRY-00374'
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE

-- First, get all order lines for Wayfair-JP-23 in 2023 with completed orders
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS order_line_qty,
        ol.unit_price,
        o.order_date,
        l.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        s.is_bundle,
        s.title
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON l.sku_id = s.sku_id
    JOIN store st ON o.store_id = st.store_id
    WHERE st.store_name = 'Wayfair-JP-23'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2023-12-31'
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode BOM for each order line
-- We track: the original order line, the current item we're expanding, its kind/code, and accumulated quantity
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: start from SKU level
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.order_line_qty,
        ol.sku_code AS root_sku_code,
        'sku' AS item_kind,
        ol.sku_code AS item_code,
        ol.order_line_qty AS accumulated_qty,
        1 AS level
    FROM order_lines ol
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand based on composition edges valid on order_date
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.line_no,
        be.order_date,
        be.order_line_qty,
        be.root_sku_code,
        uc.child_kind AS item_kind,
        uc.child_code AS item_code,
        be.accumulated_qty * uc.qty AS accumulated_qty,
        be.level + 1 AS level
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_kind = be.item_kind 
       AND uc.parent_code = be.item_code
       AND uc.valid_from <= be.order_date
       AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    WHERE be.item_kind IN ('sku', 'model', 'component')
      AND (be.item_kind != 'component' OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM component c 
          WHERE c.component_code = be.item_code AND c.is_assembly = true
      ))
),

-- Get final component-level items (parts and assemblies that couldn't expand further)
final_components AS (
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.line_no,
        be.order_date,
        be.order_line_qty,
        be.root_sku_code,
        be.item_kind,
        be.item_code,
        be.accumulated_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    WHERE be.item_kind = 'component'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM component c 
          WHERE c.component_code = be.item_code AND c.is_assembly = true
      )
      -- Also need to ensure we don't have further expansions
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM u_composition uc 
          WHERE uc.parent_kind = 'component' 
            AND uc.parent_code = be.item_code
            AND uc.valid_from <= be.order_date
            AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
      )
)

-- Sum up all consumed quantities of the specific part
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(fc.accumulated_qty), 0) AS total_consumed
FROM final_components fc
WHERE fc.item_code = 'LEG-148-WAL-02453'
```

```sql
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
),

-- For bundle SKUs, explode to item SKUs using composition
-- For non-bundle SKUs, keep as-is

    -- Non-bundle SKUs: map directly
    SELECT 
        osq.listing_id,
        osq.line_qty,
        osq.sku_code AS parent_sku_code,
        osq.sku_code AS item_sku_code,
        1 AS bundle_qty
    FROM order_sku_qty osq
    WHERE osq.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: explode to child item SKUs
    SELECT 
        osq.listing_id,
        osq.line_qty,
        osq.sku_code AS parent_sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS item_sku_code,
        uc.qty AS bundle_qty
    FROM order_sku_qty osq
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
                          AND uc.parent_code = osq.sku_code
                          AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
    WHERE osq.is_bundle = true
      AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= uc.valid_to)
),

-- Map item SKUs to company models
sku_to_model AS (
    SELECT 
        se.listing_id,
        se.line_qty,
        se.item_sku_code,
        se.bundle_qty,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sku_exploded se
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
                          AND uc.parent_code = se.item_sku_code
                          AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= uc.valid_to)
),

-- Calculate total model units: line_qty * bundle_qty * model_qty_per_sku
model_units AS (
    SELECT 
        model_code,
        line_qty * bundle_qty * model_qty_per_sku AS total_units
    FROM sku_to_model
)

SELECT model_code
FROM model_units
GROUP BY model_code
ORDER BY SUM(total_units) DESC
LIMIT 3
```

```sql
        osq.sku_code AS child_sku_code,
        osq.line_qty AS qty_at_sku_level,
        1 AS depth,
        osq.is_bundle
    FROM order_sku_qty osq
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand: if current is a bundle, expand to its children
    SELECT 
        se.listing_id,
        se.line_qty,
        se.child_sku_code AS parent_sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS child_sku_code,
        se.qty_at_sku_level * uc.qty AS qty_at_sku_level,
        se.depth + 1,
        child_sk.is_bundle
    FROM sku_expansion se
    JOIN u_composition uc ON se.child_sku_code = uc.parent_code 
        AND uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' 
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    JOIN sales_sku child_sk ON uc.child_code = child_sk.sku_code
    WHERE se.is_bundle = true
),

-- Get leaf SKUs (non-bundle) with their total quantities
leaf_sku_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        listing_id,
        child_sku_code AS sku_code,
        SUM(qty_at_sku_level) AS total_qty
    FROM sku_expansion
    WHERE is_bundle = false
    GROUP BY listing_id, child_sku_code
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Also include non-bundle SKUs that were never expanded (direct non-bundle sales)
    SELECT 
        osq.listing_id,
        osq.sku_code,
        osq.line_qty AS total_qty
    FROM order_sku_qty osq
    WHERE osq.is_bundle = false
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM sku_expansion se 
          WHERE se.listing_id = osq.listing_id 
            AND se.parent_sku_code = osq.sku_code
      )
),

-- Now map SKUs to company models
sku_model_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        lsq.sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        SUM(lsq.total_qty * uc.qty) AS model_qty
    FROM leaf_sku_qty lsq
    JOIN u_composition uc ON lsq.sku_code = uc.parent_code
        AND uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
        AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    GROUP BY lsq.sku_code, uc.child_code
)

FROM sku_model_qty
GROUP BY model_code
ORDER BY SUM(model_qty) DESC
LIMIT 3;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE 
-- First, get all completed orders in CA in 2023
ca_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.country = 'CA'
      AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < '2024-01-01'
),

-- Order lines with their quantities
order_lines AS (
    SELECT ol.listing_id, ol.qty
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN ca_orders co ON ol.order_id = co.order_id
),

-- SKU quantities sold (accounting for bundle expansion)
-- Need to expand bundles recursively
sku_sales AS (
    -- Base: direct SKU sales from order lines
    SELECT 
        l.sku_id,
        SUM(ol.qty) as total_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    GROUP BY l.sku_id
),

-- Recursive expansion of bundles to get leaf SKUs
-- A bundle SKU -> item SKU via u_composition
expanded_skus AS (
    -- Base: start with all SKUs that were sold
    SELECT 
        ss.sku_id as root_sku_id,
        ss.sku_id as current_sku_id,
        ss.total_qty as base_qty,
        1 as multiplier,
        ss.total_qty as qty
    FROM sku_sales ss
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand bundles
    SELECT 
        e.root_sku_id,
        (SELECT sku_id FROM sales_sku WHERE sku_code = uc.child_code) as current_sku_id,
        e.base_qty,
        e.multiplier * uc.qty as multiplier,
        e.base_qty * e.multiplier * uc.qty as qty
    FROM expanded_skus e
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON e.current_sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_code = ss.sku_code 
        AND uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' 
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
),

-- Get leaf SKUs (non-bundle) with their total quantities
leaf_sku_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(e.current_sku_id, e.root_sku_id) as sku_id,
        SUM(e.qty) as qty
    FROM expanded_skus e
    WHERE e.current_sku_id NOT IN (
        SELECT sku_id FROM sales_sku WHERE is_bundle = true
    )
    OR e.root_sku_id = e.current_sku_id  -- Non-bundle SKUs that never got expanded
    GROUP BY COALESCE(e.current_sku_id, e.root_sku_id)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Add non-bundle SKUs that were sold directly (not part of any bundle expansion chain)
    SELECT 
        ss.sku_id,
        ss.total_qty as qty
    FROM sku_sales ss
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON ss.sku_id = sk.sku_id
    WHERE sk.is_bundle = false
      AND ss.sku_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT root_sku_id FROM expanded_skus WHERE root_sku_id != current_sku_id)
),

-- Deduplicate and sum
final_sku_qty AS (
    SELECT sku_id, SUM(qty) as qty
    FROM leaf_sku_qty
    GROUP BY sku_id
),

-- Map SKUs to company models
sku_to_model AS (
    SELECT 
        fsq.sku_id,
        cm.model_id,
        cm.model_code,
        fsq.qty * uc.qty as model_qty
    FROM final_sku_qty fsq
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON fsq.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_code = ss.sku_code 
        AND uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
        AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' 
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_code = uc.child_code
)

SELECT model_code
FROM (
    SELECT 
        model_code,
        SUM(model_qty) as total_model_qty
    FROM sku_to_model
    GROUP BY model_code
    ORDER BY total_model_qty DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get the model_id for the given model code
target_model AS (
    SELECT model_id, model_code
    FROM company_model
    WHERE model_code = 'AL2-120BLK08-0008'
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode BOM: find all parts (non-assembly components) at any level
-- Starting from the target model, going through model->component and assembly->component edges
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct children of the model (model -> component)
    SELECT 
        c.component_id,
        c.component_code,
        c.name,
        c.category,
        c.is_assembly,
        c.unit_cost,
        uc.qty as qty_per_parent,
        1 as level
    FROM u_composition uc
    JOIN target_model tm ON uc.parent_code = tm.model_code AND uc.parent_kind = 'model'
    JOIN component c ON uc.child_code = c.component_code AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= '2023-05-22' AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR '2023-05-22' <= uc.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: children of assembly components (assembly component -> component)
    SELECT 
        c.component_id,
        c.component_code,
        c.name,
        c.category,
        c.is_assembly,
        c.unit_cost,
        be.qty_per_parent * uc.qty as qty_per_parent,
        be.level + 1
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_code = be.component_code AND uc.parent_kind = 'component'
    JOIN component c ON uc.child_code = c.component_code AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
    WHERE be.is_assembly = true
      AND uc.valid_from <= '2023-05-22' AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR '2023-05-22' <= uc.valid_to)
)
-- Sum up costs for all parts (non-assembly components) with their accumulated quantities
SELECT ROUND(SUM(qty_per_parent * unit_cost), 2) as total_parts_cost
FROM bom_explosion
WHERE is_assembly = false;
```
